cases.observed: Product HTML contains regular/current price $695 and label 'Save $-695'.
cases.risk: Negative savings copy is misleading as a display string; browser visibility, discount model and current live value unverified.
cases.vsn_guard: Calculate percent/fixed saving only if compare_at_price > price and variant eligible; never output negative values or sale label without genuine saving.

cases.observed: Cart page footer says free worldwide shipping on orders of $99; newer homepage offers 'Free standard shipping on all orders'.
cases.risk: Conflicting cross-page thresholds and unknown customer market/promotion; older cart source may be outdated.
cases.vsn_guard: Use same merchant-configured markets/shipping-policy source in all bars, product snippets and carts; no stale hardcoded default.

cases.observed: Homepage countdown section presents a 12-day/12-hour/12-minute/12-second teaser alongside Black Friday sales and Spring merchandising.
cases.risk: Only sample source labels; not proof of a running timer, real promotion, deadline or invalid countdown.
cases.vsn_guard: Tie campaign status to explicit legitimate end datetime and timezone, show expired fallback and merchant-verified discount.

cases.observed: Homepage includes comparison spec rows, variant color text, Quick Add buttons and multiple sold-out labels.
cases.risk: Presence of DOM controls and sold-out text does not establish working comparison, accessibility, variant cart behavior or current stock.
cases.vsn_guard: Separate theme-native structured spec table from optional VSN compare app; run actual keyboard/card/cart tests in later QA.

cases.observed: Coffee maker PDP source says one item remaining plus merchant sample sustainability and shipping claims.
cases.risk: Source is stale; quantity may have changed, and environmental/fulfillment claims cannot be validated via static demo.
cases.vsn_guard: Inventory from selected variant truth only with configurable real threshold; merchant substantiates pickup, shipping and sustainability claims.
